title: SongUploaded
description: Published by Upload on routing key song.uploaded after the audio (and lyrics, if any) are stored in S3 and the upload is committed. Carries the canonical song metadata so Catalogue can create the initial Song record. Consumed by Catalogue, Lyrics and Waveform. Upload may add further payload fields; consumers ignore fields they do not use.

audio_reference.description: S3 object key of the uploaded audio in the audio bucket, e.g. "audio/<song_id>.mp3".

lyrics_reference.description: S3 object key of the uploaded timestamped lyrics (LRC format) in the same bucket, e.g. "lyrics/<song_id>.lrc". Absent or null when the song has no lyrics (instrumental).

duration_ms.description: Audio duration in milliseconds, if Upload measured it. Otherwise unknown until Waveform reports it.
